body: Wrapped bread and canned corn tied together with torn yellow-black tape. A numbered tag hangs from the knot—same number marked on the tape in permanent marker. Handed out in the queue before they closed off the route.
title: Food ration, Thursday morning

body: We pitched the tent beyond the trial orchard, well outside the sprayed rows. Rain ran down the canvas and left the same yellow dust on our cups. My daughter had not eaten anything from the orchard.
title: Bitter rain at camp
